name: phys-j2-interface-backend-setting
title: Jolt J2 (+ A1 follow-up): IPhysicsBackend additions (backend id, get/set body state, snapshot hooks), physics.backend project setting read at Init, and the three A1 low fixes
issue: Physics investigation C:/Method Notes Obsidian/orchestrator/proposals/physics-backend-investigation-156.md (decisions P1-P11 ACCEPTED 2026-10-20: Jolt as a second 3D backend, backend chosen PER PROJECT via physics.backend read at Init, PhysX stays the default, strict float). Read sections 1.1, 4.2 (selection, coexistence, declaration), 4.3, 4.4 (snapshot/restore API seam additions) and the J2 line of 6.3 FIRST, plus the merged A1 (engine/src/network/*, IPhysicsBackend GetDeterminism/SupportsSnapshot/SupportsSetState, Network row), the merged J1 state (Jolt vendored: PR #195 may still be merging: this item must NOT depend on the Jolt target) and docs/physics.html. THIS ITEM IS J2 + A1 LOW FIXES. SCOPE: (1) IPhysicsBackend additions with defaults so PhysX and mocks keep compiling: a backend id/name (enum or string: 'physx', 'jolt'), body state get/set (position, rotation, linear and angular velocity, sleeping) with the PhysX implementation using setGlobalPose/setLinearVelocity/setAngularVelocity/setWakeCounter/putToSleep per the investigation (PhysX SupportsSetState becomes TRUE only if you implement and test it; if a part cannot be done safely say so and keep it false), snapshot hooks signatures per 4.4 (SaveState/RestoreState/StateHash returning 'unsupported' by default); (2) the physics.backend project setting (values physx|jolt, default physx, validated and clamped with a WARNING on a bad value like the other settings; read in Application::Init the way physics.deterministic is read), backend selection at Init: 'jolt' when no Jolt backend is compiled in is a clear logged error and a refused start for the deterministic preset or a fall-back to physx with a warning otherwise (decide per the investigation 4.2 and record as a deviation); the Network preset validation uses the SELECTED backend's GetDeterminism; health row detail names the backend; the Deterministic preset locks the backend to jolt in the preset table data (the table row exists from A1: update its value, keep the L/T/S class); (3) A1 LOWS (the user accepted them as follow-ups): the none preset must not keep an earlier simulation mode: Shutdown (or Init for none) resets the mode to None with a test; the authoritative preset's no-drop clock has no resync: add the documented default behaviour that a clock that ends a frame behind by more than a bounded amount (a named constant, e.g. 1 second of ticks) reports through the existing behind handler or resets via ResetAccumulator with a logged warning ONLY in the authoritative/deterministic modes (decide and record; None unchanged byte-for-byte), tested with the headless stepping API; fix the stale header comments Application.hpp:101 and SimulationClock.hpp:11; (4) TESTS (all legs): setting parse/clamp/default, selection logic (physx default; unavailable jolt behaviour), PhysX body get/set round trips (PhysX-only tests behind N2ENGINE_PHYSX_ENABLED), the A1 lows, the none path unchanged; (5) DOCS: docs/physics.html (the setting, selection, interface additions), docs/application.html, docs/testing.html. Nothing builds locally for the engine; CI (11 checks) is the test; expect fix rounds; re-read every edit twice (CMake/YAML/C++ syntax); verify every docs sentence against the CODE; no attribution lines on commits; GitHub only via the wrapper.
acceptance: IPhysicsBackend additions with safe defaults; PhysX body state get/set implemented and tested or honestly left unsupported
physics.backend setting read at Init with selection logic and honest health/preset behaviour; none path unchanged
A1 lows fixed with tests (mode reset, bounded resync, stale comments)
